status: DEFERRED by the owner: the evidence-agent tool route comes first; reasoning on/off and the reasoning/output mismatch are evaluated separately later
question: Can a request to qwen/qwen3.7-flash on the pinned Alibaba route turn reasoning off, and would the provider show that it did?

evidence.source: OpenRouter endpoint inventory for qwen/qwen3.7-flash, recorded 2026-10-12
evidence.fact: supported_parameters lists reasoning and include_reasoning (also max_tokens, temperature, top_p, seed, presence_penalty, response_format, logprobs, top_logprobs, tools, tool_choice)

reasoning.effort "none" asks the provider to disable reasoning; reasoning.exclude only hides the reasoning text from the response and does not stop it; disabling is passed to the provider and is not guaranteed by OpenRouter
qwen3.7-flash is a hybrid model with thinking on by default; enable_thinking=false turns it off. Whether reasoning tokens are reported as zero when it is off is not documented.
reasoning tokens were 83.3% of the measured cost; every request had reasoning on (no reasoning field sent)

notVerified: that OpenRouter maps reasoning.effort none (or enabled false) to enable_thinking=false on the Alibaba route
that usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens is 0 when reasoning is off
that require_parameters=true still selects the Alibaba endpoint when a reasoning field is present
whatAMeasurementWouldNeed: a separate plan with its own SHA, budget and approval: the same pinned request with and without a reasoning field, judged only by provider-reported usage and finish fields. The reasoning text is never used to change an answer.
notInD411Canary: The D4.11 tool canary sends no reasoning field (endpoint default), as D4.10 did.
